findings.text: the node's gate runs this file plus two invariant modules but never runs tests/test_a_request_that_cannot_launch_costs_nothing.py, which imports the changed claim module and already fails two cases at the base revision (one named for a stopped run's claim, recorded in pre-existing-unrelated-failures-at-base.log), so the done_when's 'the tests that import the changed modules add no failure' is unmeasured for the file most exposed to the change

the broadened 'except Exception' and the entire _review_record_paths review-store arm carry no assertion: restoring 'except (OSError, CrewError)', or dropping review records from the quiet-window set, reddens no test, so the head commit's 'an unreadable store keeps the claim' behaviour is unprotected

_delivered_status duplicates the fresh terminal-manifest read owned by reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:2542 stopped_with_terminal_manifest (the same _manifest_freshness plus parse_manifest block, differing only in the accepted status set and error handling), and DELIVERED_MANIFEST_STATUSES at line 182 restates literals owned by reckon/crew/reports.py:128 TERMINAL_MANIFEST_STATUSES without deriving from it; a shared fresh-manifest-status reader in reports.py would own both
